content.text: In Bangladesh, digital creators face a stark reality: Stripe and PayPal are not options. Your ability to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-5|How How]], courses, or templates hinges on infrastructure you control. Conventional platforms gatekeep [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-broken-here-infrastructure|payment]] processing, leaving you dependent on their terms. Sovereign commerce infrastructure changes this. It’s not a workaround—it’s a base-layer system where you own the storefront, the customer list, and the wallet. No platform suspension risk. No geographic gatekeeping. This post compares your real options, including COREMERCH’s [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-github-pages-free-digital-product|COREMERCH guide to complete]] Builder Kit, against the platforms that locked you out. The tradeoffs are clear. The choice is yours.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy offer convenience—until they don’t. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery, but at the cost of ownership. Your store lives on their servers. Your customer data sits in their database. Your payment processing relies on their integrations. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit flips this. It deploys a stack where GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Payment verification runs through NOWPayments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. You own the code, the data, and the wallet. No platform can suspend your store. No geography can block your payments. The tradeoff? You manage deployment. The reward? Infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Paddle or Gumroad rely on payment processors that blacklist entire countries. If you’re in Bangladesh, their terms outright exclude you. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by removing the middleman. NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions directly on-chain—no bank, no processor, no KYC. Your customers pay in USDT, USDC, or SOL. The webhook fires the moment the payment confirms. No third party can block the transaction. COREMERCH’s stacks are designed for regions where financial isolation is real. Built in Zimbabwe, they’re pressure-tested against currency collapse and payment rejection. The Complete Builder Kit includes blueprints for five stacks, each configured to operate in restricted environments. Choose based on your technical comfort, not a platform’s terms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus monthly fees for “premium” features. Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5%. On networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON, transaction fees stay under $0.10. Payment confirmation is instant—no waiting for bank settlements. COREMERCH’s stacks automate delivery the moment payment hits your wallet. No manual intervention. No platform delay. The Complete Builder Kit costs $197, a one-time fee. After deployment, your only cost is the 0.5% transaction fee. Compare this to platforms that charge monthly subscriptions plus per-transaction fees. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates recurring costs. You pay for the tools once, own them forever.
Sovereign infrastructure means no platform can suspend your store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On platforms like Gumroad, your store, customer data, and product files are theirs to access—or delete. COREMERCH’s stacks give you full ownership. Your storefront code lives in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Customer data sits in your Supabase or Google Sheets. Product files are stored in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment goes directly to your wallet. Automation is built into the stack. A customer pays, the webhook triggers, and the product delivers instantly. No platform has access after deployment. No subscription required. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for instant deployment. You own the infrastructure. You control the process.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re a digital creator in Bangladesh with no technical background, start with the Sovereign Starter Stack. It deploys in 48 hours using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Three products loaded, 30-day support included. For more control, the Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, end-to-end tested. If you want full flexibility, the Complete Builder Kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates. Deploy on your timeline, own everything immediately. The choice depends on your comfort with infrastructure. Every option removes platform dependency. Every option gives you payment sovereignty. Choose the architecture that matches your needs—not the platform’s limitations.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives digital creators in restricted countries like Bangladesh full ownership of their storefront, customer data, and payment processing. Unlike platforms that gatekeep payments and suspend accounts, COREMERCH’s stacks use open tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to ensure no third party can block transactions. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for instant deployment, eliminating platform dependency and geographic restrictions.
Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5%—no KYC required.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit includes all six blueprints, seven templates, and instant download access. Built for creators in regions where conventional platforms fail, it gives you full ownership of your infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform access. Just sovereign commerce. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity, Edge Commerce Stack for control, or Complete Builder Kit for full flexibility. 2. Set up hosting: Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront. 3. Configure backend logic: Deploy Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. 4. Store data: Use Supabase or Google Sheets for customer and order history. 5. Deliver products: Upload files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Integrate payments: Connect NOWPayments for automatic crypto verification. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure payment triggers instant product delivery. 8. Deploy: Push your stack live and own your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I have no technical skills?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack is designed for non-technical creators. It deploys in 48 hours using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for instant deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, USDC, SOL, and BTC. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. After purchasing the stack, your only cost is the 0.5% transaction fee charged by NOWPayments. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees.
What happens if a payment fails?
The stack automatically verifies payments on-chain. If a payment fails, the product is not delivered. The customer can retry immediately without manual intervention.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my business grows?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. You can add more products, increase storage, and optimize performance as needed.
Own your storefront, customer data, and wallet after deployment.
